new_issue.title: Fix search timeouts on large workspaces
new_issue.body:
## Goal
Search on workspaces with 50k+ documents times out (12s+ queries) and support tickets are piling up.

<!-- drift:plan -->
**Plan:** Postgres GIN index on `documents` + hot-query cache · **Owner:** Sam · **Target:** Fri Aug 7
<!-- /drift:plan -->

- [ ] GIN index migration
- [ ] Hot-query cache
- [ ] Verify p95 < 500ms on a 50k-doc workspace

_Filed by Drift from Monday Standup (2026-08-03)._
